questions.q: Define the null hypothesis in hypothesis testing.
a: The statement that there is no effect or no difference, assumed true until evidence indicates otherwise
The hypothesis that the researcher wishes to prove
The alternative explanation for experimental results
The probability of making a Type I error

questions.q: What is a Type I error in hypothesis testing?
a: Failing to reject a false null hypothesis
Accepting the alternative hypothesis when it is false

questions.q: What is a Type II error in hypothesis testing?
a: Failing to reject the alternative hypothesis when it is true
Failing to reject a false null hypothesis

questions.q: What does the significance level of a hypothesis test represent?
a: The probability of making a Type II error
The probability of accepting the null hypothesis
The probability of making a Type I error when the null hypothesis is true

a: To bridge the gap between discrete binomial probabilities and continuous normal probabilities

What is the power of a hypothesis test defined as?

The probability of correctly rejecting a false null hypothesis
The probability of accepting a true null hypothesis

questions.q: If a researcher wants to decrease the probability of a Type II error without changing the significance level alpha, what action should be taken?
a: Use a two-tailed test instead of a one-tailed test

Reject H0 at the 1 percent significance level
